exploit_name: Changing entropy provider during active drawing causes permanent protocol deadlock
description: If entropy provider changed after randomness requested but before callback, callback from old provider fails and new provider hasn't been invoked.
root_cause: If entropy provider changed after randomness requested but before callback, callback from old provider fails and new provider hasn't been invoked.
fix_description: Prevent entropy provider changes during active draws.
notes: Drawing settlement permanently fails. Protocol enters deadlocked state.
